content.text: The visible test now passes. I only changed `solution/core.py`. The bug was an off-by-one in `TTLCache._expired`. It used `clock() - ts > ttl`, so an entry was still returned at exactly `ttl` seconds old. The test expects the entry to be gone at that moment, so I changed the check to `>=`. I also made two related changes in the same file that the visible test doesn't check, so please look them over. First, `put` now always clears expired entries before inserting a new key, then evicts least-recently-used entries until there's room. Before, it only cleaned up when the live count was at capacity, so expired entries could pile up and push the internal store past its capacity. Second, `__len__` now clears expired entries first, so it counts only live entries instead of including dead ones. The public API, `TTLCache`, is unchanged.
